A large '''yellow insectoid''' was picked out of a hole in the ground on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] by a [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] shaman who was searching for ingredients for his magic potion, and the Dulok quickly placed the bug into his sack so that he could use it later.<ref name="1-02" />
